This '''duel''' took place circa [[3997 BBY]], just before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Jolee Bindo]] and [[Nayama]], husband and wife as well as teacher and apprentice, were divided when Nayama wanted to abandon the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and join [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Brotherhood of the Sith]]. Bindo refused and Nayama attacked him. Bindo was victorious, but could not bring himself to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Nayama, and she fled.

==Prelude==
When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] was recruiting Jedi into his newly formed Brotherhood of the Sith, Jedi Padawan Nayama was swayed by Kun's teachings and promise of a new [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. She went to her husband, Bindo, who was her teacher despite being only a Padawan himself. She pleaded with Bindo to join the Brotherhood with her, but Bindo refused and asked her to stay loyal to the Jedi Order. Enraged by his rejection, Nayama [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|attacked]] Bindo.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==The duel==
Bindo defeated Nayama after a long and terrible duel. He had her disarmed and defenseless, but could not bring himself to kill his wife. Nayama took advantage of Bindo's emotional attachment to her and escaped.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Aftermath==
Nayama joined with Kun's Brotherhood of the Sith while Bindo fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against them. Nayama killed numerous Jedi throughout the course of the war, but was slain in the war's final battle on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Bindo blamed himself for the deaths of the Jedi that Nayama killed, and blamed the Jedi Order for failing to prevent the tragedy of his wife's turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and her death. Bindo felt that he should have been punished for his actions, and when the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] cited circumstances and chose not to punish him, it was too much for him. He abandoned the order and became a [[Gray Jedi]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
